utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—are they still taking donations today?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, they’re still taking donations today. Did you want the drop-off details?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand with the repair drive. Tell me what tools you need and I’ll see what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus—I'm still sorting it out, but I think I need a wrench and maybe a flashlight. I'll check and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve been hearing about the repair drive too — sounds like a good neighborhood effort. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — that’d help a lot. I’m just trying to figure out the timing and where they want people to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the timing and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring the spare extension cords and meet me by the community shed at 4? I’ll handle the sign-in list and direct people from there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the spare extension cords and meet you by the community shed at 4.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, the repair drive is happening soon—want me to put your name down or swing by with details?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. Just swing by with the details when you can—I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll swing by with the details soon!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m starting to line up the repair drive details now. If you’re free, I’d love your help checking what needs to be fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can help with that. Send me the list, and I’ll check what should be fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — I’ll send the list over now, and we can rank the repairs from most urgent to least urgent.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I joined a bit late, so I don’t have the full details yet. Could you send me the drive info first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have it yet either, so let’s wait for the full drive details before we move ahead.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times if that makes the repair drive easier.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — if we can keep it around pickup and drop-off, I can help make the repair drive work.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s happening soon, but I’m probably a bit behind on the details. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it’s coming up soon, and I’m still filling in a few details myself. I can check what’s confirmed and pass it along so you’re not left guessing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m happy to hear whatever’s confirmed so far.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure we’re talking about the same repair drive? What does it need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, sorry — I meant what’s the biggest thing you still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still taking in the details, but I’m glad the repair drive is happening. What do you need me to know about it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — mostly just bring whatever you can spare, and don’t worry if it’s not much. I’m still a bit mixed up on the exact list, but I’ll double-check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got for the repair drive and flag anything we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Cleo — that’d really help. I’ll tell the others we’re checking supplies and see what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’m headed out on errands and can ask around.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I’d really appreciate that. I’ll be around if you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I meant to drop by and help out, but I’ve been a bit all over the place lately.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — just swing by when you can, and I’ll let folks know you’re in to help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I’ll swing by as soon as I can and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. What did I miss?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo — I probably will need them. What kind of tools can you spare?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah—just let me know, and I’ll set those aside for you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll come by tomorrow afternoon and we can go through them together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect—I'll have them ready for you tomorrow afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’m in for the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Mara — thank you! If you can bring a screwdriver set and some gloves, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll bring a screwdriver set and gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive — it’s a nice way to help everyone out. I can check with a few folks and see what tools or supplies they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be great, Jules. I can keep a list of who has what and where to pick it up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll start asking around and send you anything I find.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies list for the repair drive and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Cleo. Thank you—just let me know what’s still missing, and I’ll keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive going on—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need help with the porch gate latch and maybe the loose step. Can you take a look this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I can swing by this afternoon and take a look. I’ll check the latch and the step, then let you know what I can fix.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help by sorting donations and checking the sign-up list? That would make the repair drive run a lot smoother.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure you can help? I need someone to confirm the sign-up list and bring the tape.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can do that. I’ll confirm the sign-up list and bring the tape.
